description: Generate a video clip with sound from a text prompt on freeimagetovideo.ai, or animate a photo by passing image_url (photo to video). Defaults to MiniMax H3 at 480p. Needs a paid plan: each run draws on the plan's daily full-speed allowance, then waits in the relaxed queue (https://freeimagetovideo.ai/pricing). Video takes minutes: this returns a run id to poll with check_status.

image_url.description: Optional photo (public https URL) used as the first frame — makes this photo to video.

model.description: minimax-h3 (MiniMax H3), the model this site runs.

prompt.description: The shot: what happens, where, how the camera moves, and what it sounds like.

name: generate_video
title: Generate a video on Free Image to Video
